title: Jerked Jamaican Chicken Paella
description: A low-glycemic, earthy, and velvety Jamaican dish featuring chicken and spices, cooked to perfection in a paella pan with rapeseed oil and lardons-render.
instructions: Heat the rapeseed oil in a large paella pan over medium-high heat.
Add the diced lardons and cook until crispy, then set aside.
Add the chicken to the paella pan and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the jerk seasoning, smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper to the chicken and stir to combine.
Add the Arborio rice to the paella pan and cook for 1-2 minutes, stirring constantly.
Add the chicken broth to the paella pan and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer for 20-25 minutes, or until the rice is cooked and the liquid has been absorbed.
Stir in the chopped scallions and cooked lardons.
Serve hot, garnished with additional scallions if desired.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
